description: WP-M4c Codex: Space Marines (11e) MASTER TACTICIAN and CODEX ADEPT (Marneus Calgar), SEEKER OF THE UNFOUND (Vulkan He'stan), RAISE THE BANNER and HONOUR OF THE COMPANY (Ancient). Fixture sm11e_m4c_move (P1 Space Marines' Movement phase): Calgar 3" behind an Intercessor Squad; Vulkan next to the right no-man's-land objective (obj_nml_2); the Ancient alone on P1's home objective. Entering the Movement phase opens P1's phase_start window: a real click on Master Tactician's 'Intercessor Squad: Assault Doctrine' option makes the assault doctrine active for the Intercessors; a real click on Seeker of the Unfound + obj_nml_2 in the objective picker gives Vulkan OC 10 / FNP 4+ there. Calgar's own unit has all three doctrines (Codex Adept). Ending the Movement phase (End Movement button) secures the home objective the Ancient controls (Raise the Banner); the Ancient has OC 3 (printed 2, Honour of the Company).
